summary: Master prompt engineering for data analytics to generate accurate code, automate analysis, and validate insights. Join our 5-day intermediate course for hands-o
lede: Prompt Engineering for Data and Analytics teaches you to turn complex data requirements into precise instructions for large language models. You will learn to guide Python and SQL generation, describe dataset structures clearly, and request outputs in formats such as JSON or CSV. The course provides a structured, repeatable approach for reducing hallucinated code, schema misunderstandings, and generic analysis. Through hands-on exercises, you will refine prompts, debug errors, apply domain-specific examples, and create reusable templates for analytics tasks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for data professionals who need to integrate AI into their analytics workflows to accelerate code generation, automate analysis, and improve insight quality.
audience: Operations Managers using AI for process optimization
modules: Foundations of Prompt Engineering for Data
Code Generation and Debugging with AI
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic data concepts (e.g., tables, columns, rows) and familiarity with using a web browser to access AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude. No programming experience is required, but understanding the difference between SQL and Python is helpful. A laptop with internet access is mandatory for hands-on labs. Pre-course setup includes creating a free account on a major LLM platform.
